versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the applying-brand-guidelines skill.
- Ensures all generated documents (PowerPoint, Excel, PDF) adhere to Acme Corporation’s corporate brand standards.
- Defines approved color palette, font hierarchy, and precise logo usage requirements.
- Provides specific templates and formatting rules for presentations, spreadsheets, and PDFs.
- Outlines content guidelines including tone of voice, standard phrases, and data presentation formats.
- Includes quality control checklist and lists prohibited design elements.
- Provides scripts for automatic brand application and validation.
